description: Layout archetypes: what the page is shaped like. Structure only. No colour, no type names.

cards.name: Broadsheet
cards.borrow: single reading column, large standfirst, marginal sidenotes, one pull statistic
cards.phone: sidenotes fold inline under their paragraph

cards.name: Scrollytelling spine
cards.borrow: sticky figure on one side, text steps scroll past, figure state changes per step
cards.reduced: all steps stacked, figure shows its final state
cards.phone: figure sits above the steps and is not sticky

cards.name: Instrument panel
cards.borrow: KPI strip across the top, small multiples beneath, dense tables with inline bars
cards.phone: KPI strip wraps to two columns, tables scroll inside their wrapper

cards.name: Swiss poster
cards.borrow: rigid twelve column grid, one oversized numeral or word, hairline rules, generous empty space
cards.phone: grid collapses to one column, the oversized element keeps its scale

cards.name: Subway map
cards.borrow: nodes on parallel coloured lines, interchanges mark hand-offs between skills or agents
cards.phone: diagram scrolls inside its wrapper, legend stays above it

cards.name: Ledger
cards.borrow: table first, sticky header, inline spark bars, status glyph in the first column
cards.phone: table scrolls horizontally inside its wrapper with the first column pinned

cards.name: Slide stage
cards.borrow: fixed stage scaled to the viewport, arrow key navigation, builds per slide
cards.reduced: every build step shown at once
cards.phone: stage scrolls as a stacked sequence of slides

cards.name: Case file
cards.borrow: index rail on one side, dossier sections on the other, one open at a time
cards.phone: rail becomes a top list, tabs become stacked sections

cards.name: Swimlane timeline
cards.borrow: lanes per agent or skill, time left to right, dependency arrows crossing lanes
cards.phone: lanes scroll sideways inside the wrapper

cards.name: Compare split
cards.borrow: before and after halves with a draggable or keyboard operable divider
cards.reduced: both states shown side by side
cards.phone: states stack vertically, before above after

cards.name: Anatomy
cards.borrow: annotated figure with numbered callouts tied to a key beside it
cards.reduced: callouts rendered as an ordered list
cards.phone: figure above, callouts as a list below

cards.name: Moodfield
cards.borrow: type fragments, interview quotes, token chips and texture on one composed field
cards.phone: fragments reflow into a single column, order preserved

cards.name: Orbit hub
cards.borrow: the feature at the centre, capabilities on spokes, each spoke opens a short note
cards.phone: spokes become a list under the centre node

cards.name: Ranked board
cards.borrow: a single ranked list as the page, each row carries a bar, an id and one action
cards.phone: rows keep id and bar, secondary columns drop to a details line

cards.name: Bento grid
cards.borrow: excluded by default: everything-a-rounded-card is a banned tell
